app.name: Seamless Workshop
app.description: One window to install, update, turn on and off, and set up DavidHiFi's Windhawk mods
app.changes: DavidHiFi's whole setup in one go: every mod he runs, his own and the ones from the Windhawk library. Copy it with his settings, or install everything turned off with default settings. "Clean slate first" takes your current mods off before the setup goes in. A backup of them is...

mods.name: Ableton Glass Fill
mods.description: Matches Ableton's menu bar and Settings window to its title bar glass, and keeps the glass tint Mocha

mods.name: Always On Top Plus
mods.description: Pin any window above all others with a hotkey, with a highlight border, opacity and sounds

mods.name: Better Volume Mixer Plus
mods.description: A compact tray volume mixer with per-app volume up to 1000%, a per-app compressor, and per-app output and input devices

mods.name: Dark Theme Browser Colors Fix Plus
mods.description: Fixes web pages that show white text on white or black text on dark under the Windows dark theme, and never crashes the browser when it closes
mods.changes: The browser no longer crashes when it closes. The old version could touch its own brush list after Windows had already torn it down. Helium only gets the fix on builds listed in the settings. A new Helium build is skipped quietly until you add it, so an update can never take the...

mods.name: Explorer Tags Plus
mods.description: Colored tags panel in File Explorer's navigation pane, plus a Tags submenu in the right-click menu
mods.changes: The thin line above the Tags title is gone, so the panel sits in the folder tree with no divider.

mods.name: Explorer Tree Guard
mods.description: Stops File Explorer windows crashing when the folder tree gets a request from a thread that already gave up

mods.name: File Operation Styler Plus
mods.description: Modern copy, move, delete and recycle progress window for File Explorer

mods.name: Halo Launcher
mods.description: Press a key, type a few letters, press Enter: apps, files, sums, web searches and every module

mods.name: Helium Acrylic
mods.description: Keeps Helium's acrylic surface, Catppuccin colors and system-drawn frame working after browser updates
mods.changes: The taskbar now shows your icon when Helium is signed in to a profile. Before, the taskbar kept Helium's own icon while the title bar had yours. The mod now leaves Google Chrome and other browsers alone. It used to load into anything named chrome.exe.

mods.name: Keyboard Shortcut Actions Plus
mods.description: Global shortcuts for apps and Windows actions that work on any PC and offer a download when an app is missing

mods.name: Mocha App Icons
mods.description: Gives Ableton Live and Yapfast blue to mauve icons on their windows, taskbar buttons and shortcuts
mods.changes: Fixed: when Windows saved a taskbar pin again (after an Explorer restart, for example), the pin lost its Mocha icon until the app was reopened. The mod now watches the taskbar pins and puts the icon back within a few seconds.

mods.name: Mocha Steam Icons
mods.description: Gives Steam a blue to mauve icon in the tray, on its windows and on its shortcuts
mods.changes: Fixed: when Windows saved the taskbar pin again (after an Explorer restart, for example), the pin could lose its Mocha icon. The mod now watches the taskbar pins and puts the icon back within a few seconds. Fixed: the taskbar could keep the old icon after the shortcuts changed....

mods.name: Network Speed Test Plus
mods.description: Tray speed test button next to the network icon, plus the Windows 11 network menu speed test as a native flyout: ping, jitter, download and upload measured against Cloudflare, live gauge, results chart with copy. Mocha glass, FiraCode, gradient hover. No browser, no separate app.

mods.name: Notification Center Styler Plus
mods.description: Customize the Notification Center and Action Center with themes contributed by others or create your own

mods.name: Peek
mods.description: Select a file in File Explorer and press Space to preview it, like PowerToys Peek

mods.name: Pointer Afterimage Plus
mods.description: A real motion blur for the mouse pointer, made of fading afterimages of your own cursor, with an optional particle trail and click ripples

mods.name: Power Options Button Plus
mods.description: Tray icon to switch between Windows power plans with the mouse wheel. The icon is the house tray badge with a glyph for each plan.

mods.name: Recycle Bin Tray Plus
mods.description: Adds an interactive Recycle Bin icon to the Windows 11 system tray with live state updates, drag-and-drop support, theme-aware rendering, multiple icon styles, and configurable mouse actions.

mods.name: Seamless AutoClicker
mods.description: Hold a side mouse button and left click keeps clicking, with a lock, a tray switch and its own settings window

mods.name: Seamless Autoscroll
mods.description: Hold the middle mouse button and move to scroll, like in a browser, with a frosted glass indicator, in every app
mods.changes: Seamless Autoscroll Global is now part of this mod. One mod, one set of settings, and the frosted circle in every app. Turn off Every other app too to keep it to File Explorer, browsers and your list. If you had Seamless Autoscroll Global, remove it. This version does its job.

mods.name: Seamless Borders
mods.description: Colored borders around windows, menus and notification banners

mods.name: Seamless Clipboard Manager
mods.description: Keeps everything you copy, text and images, in a searchable list you open with Win+V

mods.name: Seamless Color Picker
mods.description: A full color picker on a hotkey, with a screen magnifier, recent colors and one-click copy

mods.name: Seamless Compiz Cube
mods.description: Rounded 3D desktop cube with Mocha borders, switching desktops through Seamless Window Manager

mods.name: Seamless Crash Watch
mods.description: A notice when a program crashes or freezes. Click it and an AI agent in a terminal finds out why, like Omarchy
mods.changes: A program that freezes now gets a notice while it is still frozen, not only after Windows closes it. Wait, Close the app, or Find out why with AI. A frozen Windhawk mod helper is named, and you can restart just that mod. New Helpers page: idle Windhawk helpers give their memory...

settings.quietNever: seamless-window-manager; seamless-autoscroll; seamless-autoscroll-global; seamless-key-click; seamless-dictate; seamless-autoclicker; seamless-crosshair; seamless-borders; seamless-wobbly-windows; zoomit; seamless-snipper; fast-backspace; remap-copilot-key; force-kill-active-window; cursor-idle-fade; pointer-afterimage-plus; taskbar-hover-animations; parallax-wallpaper; halo-launcher; smart-process-priority-ram-optimizer

mods.name: Seamless Crosshair
mods.description: A crosshair over any game: presets or your own design, any color and size, shortcuts and a tray icon

mods.name: Seamless Dictate
mods.description: Press a shortcut, speak, and your words are typed where the cursor is, in any app: transcribed and cleaned up by AI in your style (natural, professional, prompt) or translated, with a free key (Groq, Gemini, Mistral and more). It also polishes text you typed and reads selected text aloud

mods.name: Seamless Explorer Search
mods.description: Start typing in any File Explorer window, or any app's Open or Save window, to search it and every drive with Everything
mods.changes: Type-to-search now works in every app's Open and Save window, not only in File Explorer. Files in the folder that window shows come first.

mods.name: Seamless Explorer View
mods.description: GPU-accelerated Explorer views with smooth scrolling and right-click submenus that populate fully
mods.changes: The thin lines in the column header are gone: the line under the column names and the short lines between columns. A hovered column name no longer runs into a line.

mods.name: Seamless Flyouts
mods.description: Blurred, rounded Catppuccin menus and flyouts that match the taskbar, plus acrylic and Mica for Windows 11 apps
mods.changes: Open and Save windows in every app now look like File Explorer: the address bar is a rounded dock, back, forward and up share one dock beside it, and the search box is gone (Seamless Explorer Search does that job, just start typing). Buttons, drop-down boxes and text boxes in...

mods.name: Seamless Key Click
mods.description: Mechanical keyboard and mouse sounds as you type and click, with every Keyboard Sounds pack, shortcuts and a tray icon

mods.name: Seamless Launchpad
mods.description: A fullscreen GPU rendered grid of all your apps in place of Start, with instant search, adjustable blur, wiggle edit mode and power buttons

mods.name: Seamless Power Action Countdown
mods.description: Mocha glass countdown before shutdown, restart, sleep or hibernation. Any key or click cancels

mods.name: Seamless Share
mods.description: Restyles the Windows 11 share window: blurred glass, your font, soft gradient hover edges

mods.name: Seamless Snipper
mods.description: Snip a region, a window or the whole screen: frozen screen, window snapping, a pixel magnifier, straight to the clipboard and your folder. Plus Magic Pointer: shake the mouse, point at anything and ask AI about it

mods.name: Seamless Sound Manager
mods.description: Change every Windows sound with a scheme: 161 presets, startup and logon sounds. A port of Sound Manager

mods.name: Seamless Taskbar
mods.description: The whole riced taskbar in one mod: system info, media, apps dock, clock, tray, AI usage and right-click tools, each with its own switch
mods.changes: In the music player, a long artist name now slides slowly like the song title instead of ending in dots. The song picture is a little bigger with a clean edge round it that lights up blue to mauve under the pointer. The progress bar has the same gap at both ends, and the glow...

mods.name: Seamless Taskbar Badge Counter
mods.description: See how many windows each taskbar app has open, on a Catppuccin Mocha badge with a gradient edge

mods.name: Seamless Title Bars
mods.description: One title bar look everywhere: colours, caption buttons, a glass title dock and native frames in every kind of app
mods.changes: Resting the pointer on the title dock keeps it lit. Before, the hover glow could switch itself off a second later, when the uptime ticked over, and flash back on as soon as the pointer moved. The dock no longer drops out for a single frame when Windows redraws a title without...

settings.colours.excludedApps: Discord*.exe, ESDDiscord.exe, FreeDictate.exe, chrome.exe, WindowsTerminal.exe, devenv.exe, windhawk-ui.exe
settings.nativeFrames.apps: chrome.exe, brave.exe, msedge.exe, opera.exe, yandex.exe, whale.exe, supermium.exe, chromium.exe, devenv.exe, PowerToys.*.exe, olk.exe, WebViewHost.exe, winword.exe, excel.exe, powerpnt.exe, msaccess.exe, onenote.exe, outlook.exe, mspub.exe, hwp.exe, Photos.exe, MuseScore*.exe, ms-teams.exe, Discord.exe, DiscordPTB.exe, DiscordCanary.exe, DiscordDevelopment.exe, LuaTools.exe

mods.name: Seamless Window Manager
mods.description: Move, resize, snap and focus windows with the mouse or keyboard, with app rules, gaps and a pause key

mods.name: Seamless Wobbly Windows
mods.description: Jelly window dragging that keeps Snap, works with Seamless Window Manager's Alt-drag, wobbles the Seamless Borders ring and can add animated color glows behind see-through windows
mods.changes: Game guard: wobbly windows and glows no longer load into games or their anti-cheat. Launchers keep the effect. Turn it off or add your own lists in the new "Game guard" settings.

mods.name: Settings Styler Plus
mods.description: Themes for the Windows Settings app, plus a blur that stays when unfocused

mods.name: Shell Font Changer Plus
mods.description: Any installed font in File Explorer, Start, Search, Settings and the shell, with icons and emoji left intact

mods.name: Simple Window Switcher Plus
mods.description: Customizable Alt+Tab with Vista animations, background blur and elevated app support

mods.name: Startup Control
mods.description: Manage startup apps, scheduled tasks and Windows startup locations.
mods.changes: The window shows its own icon on the taskbar instead of a blank one. Right-clicking the tray icon opens its menu and the menu stays open. You can open the window from this settings page: flip "Open the settings window" and press Save. This is a first release. Keep Autoruns...

mods.name: Theme Tool Plus
mods.description: Switch Windows themes from the settings tab. Comes with the Main 01 Catppuccin theme, cursors and sounds

mods.name: UWP Assets Redirect Plus
mods.description: Swap the icons of Store and system apps, with a built-in Catppuccin icon theme

mods.name: Windhawk Enhanced Styler
mods.description: Theme Windhawk itself with your own colors, gradients, font, transparency and blur
mods.changes: The full screen settings view starts below the title bar, so the save bar shows whole and its buttons work.

mods.name: Windows 11 File Explorer Styler Plus
mods.description: Customize the File Explorer with themes contributed by others or create your own
mods.changes: The back, forward, up, refresh and home dock edge now really lights blue to mauve on hover. Before, the dock was found too early and never lit. The line between the folder tree and the file list is gone with the frame-only see-through setting too, not only with the whole-window...
